transforms.name: Variable Declaration Modernization
transforms.description: Convert var declarations to const/let based on reassignment analysis

transforms.name: TypeScript Type Annotation
transforms.description: Add TypeScript type annotations to functions and parameters
examples: function greet(name) => function greet(name: string): void
const add = (a, b) => const add = (a: number, b: number): number

transforms.name: Console Statement Removal
transforms.description: Remove console.log and related console statements

transforms.name: Structured Logging Addition
transforms.description: Replace console statements with structured logging (Winston)

transforms.name: Callback to Async/Await Conversion
transforms.description: Convert callback-based code to async/await pattern

transforms.name: Try-Catch Error Handling
transforms.description: Wrap function bodies with try-catch blocks
examples: function test() { code } => function test() { try { code } catch(e) { logger.error(e) } }

transforms.name: Prettier Code Formatting
transforms.description: Format code using Prettier with project defaults
